english.meaning: to search for work; to job hunt

exampleSentences.english: Oh, job hunting nowadays is such a hassle, huh? You have to fill out so much, and so many people apply. The odds are really low.
exampleSentences.traditional: 哦，而家揾工呢，真係麻煩，呵？填咁鬼多嘢喎。但係呢又多人申請喎。機會率又細喎真係。
